inspection_scope: Complete supported StructTreeRoot K hierarchy, unique indirect child ownership, immediate P links and exact bidirectional physical-page MCID membership
known_issues: Only effective root-reachable structural links are checked, not all unreachable or historical objects.
Existing page/MCID checks run first and keep their own finite visit, depth and decoded-content limits. The new 20000-visit tree budget is additional, not an aggregate job resource attestation.
Role names are required to be native PDF names, but role maps, attributes, alternate text quality, reading order and semantic accessibility are not qualified.
No full PDF/UA claim, visual/source-text equivalence, findings assessment, scientific validation, worker authentication or release authorization follows from linkage counts.
Unsupported but otherwise valid PDF structure forms fail closed; input is never rewritten or sanitized.
The 32-page default renderer is unchanged. The optional source-aware job and other inspectors use the selected finite file class; this adapter still requires explicit composition.
supported_structure: Existing flat ParentTree profile; root K array; structure elements with nonempty K arrays, single indirect child or single integer MCID; numeric content requires an explicit physical Pg; dictionaries such as MCR/OBJR child records and nested arrays are unsupported
